title: Roasted Canadian Salmon Papillote
description: A simple and flavorful recipe that cooks salmon to perfection.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Place a salmon fillet in the center of each piece of aluminum foil.
Drizzle the lemon juice and olive oil over the salmon.
Sprinkle the parsley and minced garlic over the salmon.
Top each salmon fillet with an asparagus spear.
Fold the foil over the salmon to create a packet and crimp the edges to seal.
Place the packets on a baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through.
Remove the packets from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes.
Carefully open the packets and serve the salmon and asparagus hot.
